# relevan (Python)

> Python client for the Relevan search API — typed, generated from Relevan's live OpenAPI spec, with built-in rate-limit retry and clearly-marked beta endpoints.

## Reference

- [README](https://github.com/relevan-dev/relevan-python/blob/main/README.md): install, quickstart, auth, rate limits, beta endpoints.
- Every public method carries a full docstring (Args/Returns/Raises/Example) — introspect with `help(client.search.search)` rather than guessing signatures.
- [Relevan API's own llms.txt](https://api.relevan.dev/llms.txt): the underlying HTTP API this client wraps, including why sending feedback after a search matters.

## Notes for an agent using this package

- `Client()` / `AsyncClient()` read `RELEVAN_API_KEY` from the environment; pass `api_key=` to override.
- Call `client.organizations.list()` once to resolve `orgId` before calling any other method.
- `client.search.search(...)` returns `search_context.query_id` — pass it to `client.beta.send_feedback(...)` after acting on a result. This is not optional: it is what improves future search quality.
- Anything under `client.beta` may change without notice; each call raises `RelevanBetaWarning`.
